group_assessment.weighting: Observation and interpretation are weighted differently here and in opposite directions from the naive reading. The group is primary for the GENE in oncology, so its WWOX reagents, knockout MEF lines and antibody are first-hand and its Wwox blots are the strongest evidence in the paper. It is NOT primary for the DISEASE: WWOX AND (epilepsy OR encephalopathy OR DEE) returns 119 records in the field while Huebner K[au] and Aldaz CM[au] return 7 and 8 against those terms, none of which this reading establishes to be WWOX-DEE papers. The DSB-repair methodology is likewise NOT theirs: the DR-GFP, HW1, EJ2 and SA26 reporter systems and the Brca1 deletion mutants come from Parvin and colleagues (refs 21, 22, 26, 28, 29, 36, 37), and Parvin has exactly one WWOX paper in PubMed, this one. So the repair measurements carry borrowed-but-expert methodology, while the interpretation of what WWOX is doing is the WWOX group's, and the human-survival interpretation rests on a database neither group generated. Nothing in this paper is evidence about a neurodevelopmental phenotype.
group_assessment.note: Primary for the gene is not primary for the disease, and here the split runs through the middle of the paper: the WWOX side is first-hand, the BRCA1/repair side is methodologically borrowed, and the human side is a public-database re-analysis. research_type is 'mixed' from the closed vocabulary and the choice is deliberate: inferred from the Methods, this paper produces first-hand experimental cell biology (clonogenic survival, four integrated repair reporters, GST pulldown and co-IP, immunofluorescent foci, flow cytometry, karyotype, array CGH, a subcutaneous xenograft) AND a re-analysis of a public clinical database (REMBRANDT via the Georgetown GDOC Kaplan-Meier application) that the group did not generate. 'experimental_lab' alone would describe the mouse and cell work and silently promote the human arm to the same evidential class.
group_assessment.research_type_basis: experimental lab. The evidence this group can produce first-hand is cell-biological: clonogenic survival, integrated reporter assays for the four DSB repair pathways, co-immunoprecipitation and GST pulldown, immunofluorescent foci, flow cytometry, karyotype and array CGH, and a subcutaneous xenograft. The human arm is not theirs and is not experimental: it is a re-analysis of the public REMBRANDT brain-cancer database through a third-party Kaplan-Meier application.

field_density.note: The intersection this paper occupies is nearly empty and that is a signal, not an absence: 3 records for WWOX AND "pathway choice" and 3 for WWOX AND "end resection", against 88 for BRCA1 AND "pathway choice" and 708 for WWOX overall. Two consequences. First, almost everything the corpus can ever know about WWOX and repair-pathway choice comes from a handful of papers, of which this is one and its 2022 follow-up another, so independence between them is a load-bearing question rather than a formality. Second, the axis is essentially unconnected to the disease literature: 1 record for WWOX AND BRCA1 AND (epilepsy OR encephalopathy).

entries.proposition: Wwox-knockout MEFs survive ionising radiation better than wild-type MEFs, quantified as 10-fold at doses of 7.7 Gy and above.

entries.proposition: Figure 1a read at native resolution qualifies the 10-fold statement: the separation is neither uniform across doses nor across the two wild-type lines. At 7.7 Gy WT4 (blue) sits about 6-fold below KO3/KO5, but at 10.2 Gy the WT4 point lies on the knockout cluster at roughly 0.6% survival while only WT7 (green) has collapsed to about 0.0035%. At the highest dose one of the two wild-type lines is indistinguishable from both knockouts.
entries.snippet: Figure 1a, native embedded raster 4024x2335 px and the 3x crop of its 2.2-10.2 Gy region: four series, WT4 blue, WT7 green, KO3 orange, KO5 red, on a log survival axis; at 10.2 Gy the blue marker is superimposed on the orange/red cluster while the green marker is roughly two decades lower.
entries.anchor: Figure 1a, the 7.7 and 10.2 Gy points
entries.qualifies_needle: 10-fold better than wild-type cell lines WT4 and WT7

entries.proposition: Figure 1c qualifies the 231/Wwox survival claim by showing how narrow it is: the doxycycline-induced series terminates at 5.1 Gy, so the whole effect rests on one dose, and that point's error bar spans roughly 0.001 to 0.12% survival, more than two decades, against a Wwox-negative value of about 0.5%.
entries.snippet: Figure 1c, 3x crop: two series on a log axis from 0 to 10.2 Gy; the Dox+ (blue) line stops after the 5.1 Gy point, whose lower error bar reaches the axis floor, while the Dox- (red) line continues through 7.7 and 10.2 Gy.
entries.anchor: Figure 1c, the 5.1 Gy point and the termination of the Dox+ series
entries.qualifies_needle: the highest dose at which 231/Wwox-pos cells formed colonies

entries.proposition: Figures 1e and 1f qualify 'at 7.7 Gy and above': in 1e the two curves are superimposed through 5.1 Gy and separate at 7.7 and 10.2 Gy, but in 1f the Dox+ series carries no 10.2 Gy point at all, so 'and above' cannot be evaluated at the top dose in the second clone. The two panels also use different y-axis floors (0.01 in 1e, 0.001 in 1f).
entries.snippet: Figures 1e and 1f, 3x crop: in the KO3A panel both series run to 10.2 Gy and diverge from 7.7 Gy; in the KO5F panel the last Dox+ marker is at 7.7 Gy with an error bar to the axis floor and only the Dox- series reaches 10.2 Gy.
entries.anchor: Figures 1e and 1f, the 7.7 and 10.2 Gy points
entries.qualifies_needle: at 7.7 Gy and above (Figures 1e and f)

entries.proposition: Figure 3c qualifies the only NHEJ measurement in the paper on two counts visible in the panel: the siCtrl reference bar sits at exactly 1.0 with no error bar because the assay is normalised to it, so the P<0.05 compares a value with variance against a constant; and the Wwox immunoblot beneath the panel is the weakest in the figure, a faint smear rather than a resolved band, so the knockdown that the result depends on is poorly evidenced here.
entries.snippet: Figure 3c, 3x crop: a two-bar chart, siCtrl at 1.0 with no error bar and siWwox at about 0.375 with an upper error bar to roughly 0.52, above a Wwox blot in which the siCtrl lane shows a faint irregular smear and the vinculin loading control is clean.
entries.anchor: Figure 3c, the bar chart and its embedded immunoblot
entries.qualifies_needle: silencing Wwox significantly decreased NHEJ by 50%

entries.proposition: Figure 3i qualifies the cisplatin claim: the WT4 series carries no data point above 25 microM, while KO3 and KO5 continue to 35 and 50 microM. The comparison 'and higher concentrations vs WT4 MEF' is therefore not drawn in the panel, because above 25 microM there is no wild-type comparator.
entries.snippet: Figure 3i, 3x crop: on a log survival axis against cisplatin 0-50 microM, the blue WT4 line ends at the 25 microM point while the orange KO3 and red KO5 lines continue through 35 and 50 microM.
entries.anchor: Figure 3i, the 35 and 50 microM positions
entries.qualifies_needle: and higher concentrations vs WT4 MEF

entries.proposition: Figure 5e qualifies the interaction map on its own control lane: in the IgG co-immunoprecipitation panel the Wwox row is blank for N, M1, M2 and M3 but carries a clear band in the C lane. One of the three mutants scored as retaining Wwox binding is therefore the one whose negative control is positive, and the text never mentions it. The Brca1 rows of the HA co-IP are also saturated and smeared across M2, M3 and C, so equal bait recovery cannot be read off the panel.
entries.snippet: Figure 5e, 3x crop: three panels labelled lysate, HA coIP and IgG coIP over lanes N, M1, M2, M3, C; in the IgG coIP the Wwox row shows a single distinct band in the C lane and nothing in the other four.
entries.anchor: Figure 5e, IgG coIP panel, Wwox row, lane C
entries.qualifies_needle: at the N, M3 and C regions (lanes 6, 9 and 10; Figure 5e)

entries.proposition: Figure 6 qualifies the Brca1-recruitment negative. At 1 h the Brca1 foci means are about 2.67 with Wwox and about 4.27 without, and their standard-error bars do not overlap; the pair carries no significance mark while gammaH2AX, Rpa32 and Rad51 pairs in the same figure do. Whether this pair was tested and found non-significant, or reported as such without a mark, cannot be read off the panel, and the sentence it supports is the load-bearing negative of the model.
entries.snippet: Figure 6, 3x crop of the Brca1 quantification: eight bars at 0, 1, 3 and 6 h, Dox+ grey and Dox- black; at 1 h the grey bar reaches about 2.67 with an error bar to roughly 3.05 and the black bar about 4.27 with an error bar from roughly 4.10, and no bracket or P value is drawn over the pair.
entries.anchor: Figure 6, Brca1 foci graph, the 1 h pair
entries.qualifies_needle: no significant differences in foci of RIF1, 53BP1 or Brca1 proteins

entries.proposition: Figure 6 qualifies the Rpa32 result in time: the difference exists at 1 h (about 1.35 with Wwox against about 3.53 without) and inverts at 3 h, where the Wwox-expressing cells show the higher mean (about 3.68 against about 2.73) with wide, overlapping error bars and no mark, before both fall by 6 h. The enhanced-resection reading is a one-timepoint observation, not a sustained difference.
entries.snippet: Figure 6, 3x crop of the RPA32 quantification: the 1 h pair carries a P< 0.05 bracket with the black bar at about 3.53, and at 3 h the grey bar rises to about 3.68 while the black bar falls to about 2.73, with error bars spanning roughly 2.75-4.65 and 1.6-4.25 and no bracket.
entries.anchor: Figure 6, RPA32 foci graph, the 1 h and 3 h pairs
entries.qualifies_needle: increased foci in 231/Wwox-neg cells compared with 231/Wwox-pos cells 1 h after IR

entries.proposition: Figure 6 qualifies the end-resection hypothesis through the Rad51 baseline: at 0 h, before irradiation, the Wwox-negative cells already carry about 7.35 Rad51 foci per nucleus against about 4.07 in the Wwox-positive cells, unmarked; at 3 h the order inverts; and the Rad51 graph stops at 3 h while the other five proteins are followed to 6 h. A pre-existing difference at time zero is not attributable to irradiation-induced resection.
entries.snippet: Figure 6, 3x crop of the Rad51 quantification: six bars at 0, 1 and 3 h only; at 0 h the grey bar is about 4.07 and the black about 7.35 with no bracket, the 1 h pair carries P< 0.05, and at 3 h the grey bar is about 12.6 against about 10.4 black.
entries.anchor: Figure 6, Rad51 foci graph, the 0 h pair and the absent 6 h timepoint
entries.qualifies_needle: Wwox interaction with Brca1 suppresses DSB end resection in Wwox-sufficient cells

entries.proposition: Figure 7c qualifies the competition model in the authors' own drawing: the arrow by which Wwox blocks the Brca1-Rad50/MRN interaction is drawn with a question mark beside it. The step the model turns on is marked as unverified on the figure itself, and no Rad50 competition experiment appears anywhere in the paper.
entries.snippet: Figure 7c: Wwox is drawn beneath Brca1/CtIP with a blunt-ended inhibitory line toward the M-R-N complex, and a '?' is printed immediately beside that line; the caption beneath reads that impaired resection hampers HDR and promotes NHEJ in Wwox-sufficient cells.
entries.anchor: Figure 7c, the Wwox-to-MRN inhibitory arrow
entries.qualifies_needle: Wwox competes with Rad50 for binding to Brca1

entries.proposition: Supplementary Figure 2 qualifies the untreated negative. In panel b the mean comet tail moment is higher, not equal, on Wwox silencing (about 21.8 against about 13.6 in siCtrl, a 60% increase) with wide overlapping error bars and no significance mark; only the MEF panel c shows genuinely superimposed means (about 6.35 ko against 6.25 wt). The negative rests on non-significance with high variance in a pooled analysis, not on demonstrated equivalence.
entries.snippet: Supplementary Figure 2 panels a, b and c as deposited: gammaH2AX percent positive cells siCtrl about 12.8 against siWwox about 14.9; tail moment siCtrl about 13.6 with an error bar to about 20.5 against siWwox about 21.8 with an error bar to about 35.5; tail moment wt about 6.25 against ko about 6.35. No panel carries a significance mark.
entries.anchor: Supplementary Figure 2, panels a, b and c
entries.qualifies_needle: did not reveal differences in untreated Wwox-deficient and -expressing cells

entries.proposition: Supplementary Figure 1 qualifies the karyotype claim by what it does not contain: the figure holds two knockout karyograms and no wild-type karyogram, so the comparator for 'not present in the wild-type cell line' is not shown. No circles are drawn on either deposited image, although the legend says the deletions are marked by circles, and at the deposited 640x512 px the shortened chromosome 7 and 4 homologues are visible but a band-level assignment such as A1B4 against A1B5 is not verifiable.
entries.snippet: Supplementary Figure 1: two G-banded karyograms, each near-tetraploid with four copies of most autosomes, laid out on a template carrying empty labels 20, 21 and 22 for a 19-autosome species; one carries two marker chromosomes annotated 'M 7' and 'M 3'. Chromosome 7 and chromosome 4 each show shortened homologues. No circle annotation is present on either image.
entries.anchor: Supplementary Figure 1, both karyograms
entries.qualifies_needle: two structural abnormalities not present in the wild-type cell line

entries.proposition: Supplementary Figure 4 qualifies the exclusion of the cell-cycle alternative: the checkpoint evidence behind it is a set of raw single-film immunoblots with no densitometry anywhere, scored in Figure 4 as absent/medium/high shading. A qualitative visual grading of one film per protein, taken after 6 Gy, is what stands behind a claimed absence of correlation with responses measured at 10 Gy and at 7.7-10.2 Gy.

entries.anchor: Supplementary Figure 4, panels b and c, component films

entries.proposition: Supplementary Figure 6b confirms that doxycycline induces Wwox in all three inducible 231 lines, including the WW1 and Y293F mutants, so the Figure 5f and 5g survival comparisons rest on demonstrated expression. The induction lanes are annotated '-D' and 'D96' while every functional experiment specifies 24 h of doxycycline; what 'D96' denotes is not resolvable from the artefact.
entries.snippet: Supplementary Figure 6b as deposited: a Wwox immunoblot with handwritten lanes Scr, 13A, WT -D, WT D96, WW1 -D, WW1 D96, Y293F -D, Y293F D96, showing a strong band in each D96 lane and a faint band in each -D lane, over an evenly loaded actin control.
entries.anchor: Supplementary Figure 6b, Wwox and actin films

entries.proposition: The reporter measurements themselves, read off Figure 3: HDR rises from about 20% GFP-positive under siCtrl to about 50% under siWwox in U87 and returns to about 19.7% on rescue; the HeLa arm moves from about 2.8% to about 2.0% on Wwox expression; Alt-NHEJ falls from about 12.1% to about 5.0% with only partial rescue to about 9.6%; SSA falls from about 3.1% to about 0.88%. The rescue arms are what make these Wwox-specific rather than off-target, and the Alt-NHEJ rescue is incomplete.
entries.snippet: Figure 3 panels a, b, d, e: bar charts of % cells GFP positive with brackets P< 0.01 twice in panel a, P< 0.05 in panel b, P< 0.0001 and P< 0.001 in panel d and P< 0.0001 in panel e, each above a Wwox immunoblot with a vinculin loading control.
entries.anchor: Figure 3, panels a, b, d and e

entries.proposition: Figure 2b read at native resolution: the unirradiated control groups are plotted (medians about 10 and 13 days) with no test drawn between them, and the single P<0.05 bracket spans the two irradiated groups. With two control animals per group per the Methods, the statement that control latencies were 'not different' is an unmarked comparison, not a tested one.
entries.snippet: Figure 2b: four box plots labelled IR 0 Gy and 5 Gy under Dox- and Dox+, with a single P < 0.05 bracket drawn between the two 5 Gy boxes and no bracket between the 0 Gy boxes; the 5 Gy Dox+ box spans roughly 17 to 45 days against roughly 10 to 28 days for 5 Gy Dox-.
entries.anchor: Figure 2b, the 0 Gy and 5 Gy box plots

entries.proposition: Figure 4a and 4c read at native resolution: in the isogenic 231 pair the cycle distributions are nearly identical with and without Wwox, which supports the authors' exclusion; but in the MEFs the four lines differ substantially from each other and not only by genotype, with WT4 about 90% G1 against WT7 about 80%, KO3 carrying about 10% sub-G1 and KO5 sitting at about 48% G1 with a much larger S and G2/M fraction. The MEF panel therefore shows line-to-line heterogeneity rather than a clean genotype contrast, which is the same heterogeneity Supplementary Figure 2 pools away.
entries.snippet: Figure 4c: four stacked-column series labelled WT4, WT7, KO3 and KO5 at 0, 1, 3 and 6 h after 10 Gy, with sub-G1, G1, S, G2/M and >G2 fractions, beneath qualitative chk2 and chk1 shading rows graded absent to high.
entries.anchor: Figure 4a and 4c
